name: code-cleanup
description: Clean up a codebase so a maintainer can read, debug, and change it, without changing what it does — from one targeted change, to removing dead code and junk, to flattening call paths that jump through needless layers and splitting god functions, to a full overhaul, or a map and plan only. An empty or vague request gets a short survey and one question about the level.

defaultPrompt: Run /code-cleanup:code-cleanup (Claude Code) or $code-cleanup (Codex) in the repository, followed by what hurts in your own words — or nothing, and it surveys the project and asks which level to do.
